about: A sentence set large, with chosen words or phrases bracketed and named underneath as each is said: grammar and parts of speech, how a sentence is built, the key terms of a definition, a line of a law or a poem taken apart.

text.default: The cat sat on the mat

marks.about: words of the sentence and what they are, as words:name, split by |

when.about: moments each mark is drawn; else when its words are said, or one after another
